item.title: People Who Had To Choose Their Pet Over Their Partner Reveal How It All Went (33 Pics)
item.description: It's an ultimatum you think exists only in movie scripts. Until you hear it from your significant other.

item.title: 65 Fascinating Photos Of Everyday Objects That Have Worn Down In Unexpected Ways
item.description: From door handles to work tools, we’ve compiled a list of 65 everyday objects that have completely changed over time, and in some pretty unexpected ways.

item.title: “Please Stroke, I’m Having A Help”: 108 Times People Broke Their Brain Trying To Understand What They’d Read
item.description: We invented both Shakespeare and the word “yeet.” We put a man on the moon but still can’t figure out how to make women’s pockets bigger than two centimeters. So it’s only fitting that the internet we ended up with was never going to be calm or rational. The Facebook page “Please Stroke, I’m Having A Help” is a perfect example. It collects posts that make zero sense and might have you questioning your reading abilities—yet somehow, they’re absolutely hilarious. Just roll with it and enjoy.

item.title: If These Days Feel Weirdly Normal, Here Are 102 Posts To Prove That We Live In An Actual Dystopia
item.description: Reading Orwellian novels and watching Black Mirror used to be an entertaining form of escapism. But nowadays, these kinds of stories feel way too similar to real life. After all, we’ve seen artificial intelligence improve exponentially in recent years, and you can even buy smart glasses that will record everything you see now. Some of the ways that the world has changed are becoming pretty concerning, though. So we’ve gathered a list right here of the most dystopian things people have witnessed.

item.title: Stepdaughters’ Gift Pushes Woman To Her Limits, Shares Conversation With Her Husband That Goes Viral
item.description: What may seem like a “harmless” prank for you could be highly offensive for the person on the receiving end. And the worst thing you can do as a response is to blame them their supposed inability to take a joke. This is what a woman went through with her stepdaughters, who pulled a practical joke on her. Worse, her husband played the victim when she tried to distance herself.

item.title: 69 People Anonymously Share Secrets That Are Too Explosive People To Expose
item.description: We often use the internet to be known and seen. But it can also do the opposite: let you stay anonymous, say what you’d never admit out loud, and then return to real life with everything looking the same as ever. That kind of freedom creates some very interesting Reddit threads. In one of them, users confessed the secrets they’ve been keeping, the kind that could destroy multiple lives if they ever got out. At least online, they can get it off their chest.

item.title: Man Plays Video Games And Buys Star Wars Figures In Secret After Wife Bans His Hobbies
item.description: He loves his Star Wars figurines and playing video games. His wife knew this before they got married... Why then did she suddenly take issue with his hobbies after the wedding, going as far as ripping up and burning his collectables? And why is she surprised by his reaction?

item.title: 54 Pics That Might Make Xennials Go On A Nostalgic Trip Down Memory Lane
item.description: With the world seemingly plunged into perpetual crises, you’d be forgiven for wanting to take a break from all the stress and go back in time to the good old days. Things seemed simpler in the past. ‘Xennial Kid’ is a popular Instagram account that shares nostalgic pics, and they are a blast from the past that makes you want to put on your rose-colored glasses. We’ve picked out some of the very best images that radiate vintage goodness to give you a well-deserved break from the present.

item.title: 39 Things That Shocked People After They Got Out Of Prison
item.description: Being incarcerated not only takes away years from your life, but it also changes your perception of the outside world. In many ways, people who were locked up will have a difficult time adjusting to normal life outside of those four prison walls. Some of them shared their experiences in a recent Reddit thread.

item.title: Man Upset 27YO Son Won’t Let Him Track His Car With An AirTag “For Safety”
item.description: Absolutely everyone is entitled to privacy. When you become an adult, you expect others to respect your boundaries as you do theirs. But sometimes, some of your more controlling relatives might try to force themselves into your life without your permission. One man turned to the internet for help after finding out that his own father had been tracking his car without his permission. The older man refused to stop, even when confronted about his stalking.
